_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Vayikra 19, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then God spoke to Moses directly.
translations.2: Command the assembly of the sons of Israel, and say to them: Be consecrated, for I am God your Lord, the Holy One.
translations.3: Let every person fear his mother and his father; and keep My Sabbaths. I am God your Lord — I shall recompense you with good.
translations.4: Do not turn toward the idols; and molten objects of worship — do not make for yourselves. I am God your Lord, the One.
translations.5: And when you slaughter a sacrifice of well-being to God, slaughter it in the manner that is acceptable from you.
translations.6: It is to be eaten on the day of your slaughter and on the morrow; and whatever remains until the third day shall be burned in the fire.
translations.7: And if anything of it is eaten on the third day, it is like the repulsive thing — it shall not be accepted.
translations.8: And he who eats it has borne his burden of guilt, for he has debased what is consecrated to God; and that person shall be cut off from among his people.
translations.9: And when you harvest the grain of your lands, do not exhaust the edge of your field by harvesting it, and the gleanings of your grain — do not gather them.
translations.10: And your vineyard — do not strip it; and the fallen grapes of your vineyard — do not gather them; but leave them for the weak and the stranger. I am God your Lord — I shall recompense you with good.
translations.11: Do not steal; and let no man deny nor break faith with his fellow.
translations.12: And do not swear by My name falsely — for you would then have debased the name of your Lord. I am God, the Punisher.
translations.13: Do not defraud your fellow nor rob him; and do not let the wages of a hired hand stay overnight with you until the morning.
translations.14: Do not revile the deaf; and before a blind person do not place a stumbling block; and fear your Lord. I am God, the Punisher.
translations.15: Do not commit injustice in judgment; do not favor the poor, and do not defer to the great — but judge among your people with equity.
translations.16: Do not go about in leisurely prying among your people; and do not stand against the blood of your fellow. I am God, the Punisher.
translations.17: Do not hate your brother in your heart; but admonish him with admonition — and do not bear on his account a burden of guilt.
translations.18: Do not take revenge and do not bear a grudge against your people; and love for your fellow what you love for yourself. I am God — I shall recompense you with good.
translations.19: My statutes — keep them. Your beasts — do not mate them from two kinds; and your fields — do not sow them from two kinds; and a garment of two kinds intertwined — let it not come upon you.
translations.20: And any man who lies with a woman in the manner of procreation, and she is a maidservant betrothed to any man, and a ransom has not been paid for her and her freedom has not been given to her — then she shall be subject to punishment, and they shall not be put to death, since she has not been freed.
translations.21: And he shall bring his offering to God, to the entrance of the tent of the assembly — a ram as a guilt offering.
translations.22: And the imām shall seek forgiveness for him before God for his sin which he has sinned; and it shall be forgiven him.
translations.23: And from the time you enter the land and plant any food-bearing tree, you shall declare its fruit forbidden with a full prohibition — three years it shall be forbidden to you, not to be eaten.
translations.24: And in the fourth year, all its fruit shall be consecrated, dedicated to God.
translations.25: And in the fifth year you may eat its fruit — for I am God your Lord, I shall increase for you its yield.
translations.26: Do not eat over the blood; do not take omens and do not seek auguries.
translations.27: And do not shave the corners of your heads, and do not uproot the corners of your beard.
translations.28: And a scratch for the dead — do not place on your bodies; and tattooed writing — do not place on yourselves. I am God, the Punisher.
translations.29: And do not give over your daughter to debauchery, lest the people of the land fall into debauchery and it fill with lewdness.
translations.30: My Sabbaths — keep them; and My sanctuary — hold it in awe. I am God who has honoured them.
translations.31: Do not turn toward the conjurers and the diviners; and do not seek to disobey Me by means of them. I am God your Lord, the Knower of what is hidden.
translations.32: Before one possessed of grey hair — rise; and show gladness toward the face of the elder; and fear your Lord. I am God.
translations.33: And when a stranger settles among you in your land, do not oppress him.
translations.34: The stranger who has come to dwell among you shall be to you as a native among you; and love for him as for yourself — for you were long strangers in the land of Egypt. I am God your Lord of all of you.
translations.35: Do not commit fraud in judgment, nor in measurement, nor in weight, nor in measure.
translations.36: But just scales and just weights and just dry measures and just liquid measures shall be yours. I am God your Lord, the Just — who brought you out from the land of Egypt.
translations.37: And keep all My statutes and all My ordinances, and act according to them. I am God — I shall recompense you with good.
